text.default: Hello! I live in Sweden. How are you today?

variations: Hello! I live in Sweden. How are you today?
Hi there! It is nice to meet someone new in town.
Good day! Do you like exploring new places?
Hello! I am taking a walk around town. What brings you here?
Hi! What do you like to do in your free time?

intents.name: hobbies
keywords: what do you like to do

intents.name: food
keywords: what do you like to eat

text.default: I enjoy simple things, like walking and meeting people. What do you enjoy?
text.cheerful: I love walking around town and meeting people! What do you enjoy?
text.shy: I like quiet walks and a good book. What do you enjoy?
text.serious: I enjoy staying active after work. What do you do for fun?

text.default: I like fresh bread and a warm cup of tea. What food do you like?
text.cheerful: Fresh bread is the best! What is your favorite food?
text.shy: I like soup on a cool day. What do you like to eat?
text.serious: I like a good meal after a busy day. What is your favorite?

text.default: I work here in town. My job keeps me busy, but I like this neighborhood.
text.cheerful: I have a nice job here in town. It is lovely to see familiar faces!
text.shy: I work nearby. I like the quiet streets before the town gets busy.
text.serious: I work hard during the day. What kind of work do you enjoy?

text.default: This is a friendly town. I like the plaza and the river walk.
text.cheerful: I love this town! The plaza and river walk are lovely places to visit.
text.shy: The river walk is peaceful. It is my favorite place in town.
text.serious: The town is easy to explore. The plaza is a good place to start.

text.default: A good book makes a quiet afternoon better. What do you like to read?
text.cheerful: I always have a story to recommend! What do you like to read?
text.shy: I enjoy stories about new places. Do you like reading?
text.serious: I read to learn something new. What kind of books do you prefer?

text.default: Flowers bring color to the streets. Do you have a favorite?
text.cheerful: I love seeing flowers around town! Which ones do you like?
text.shy: I like the little flowers beside the river. What flowers do you like?
text.serious: Plants need care and patience. Do you enjoy gardening?

text.default: Music makes a walk feel shorter. What kind of music do you enjoy?
text.cheerful: I love a cheerful song! What music do you like?
text.shy: Soft music helps me relax. Do you play an instrument?
text.serious: I enjoy music after work. What do you listen to?

text.default: Animals make good walking companions. Do you have a pet?
text.cheerful: Dogs are so friendly! Do you have a pet?
text.shy: I like calm dogs. Do you like animals?
text.serious: Pets need time and care. Do you have one?

text.default: The rooftops and gardens make nice subjects to draw. Do you like art?
text.cheerful: There is so much to paint in town! What do you like to draw?
text.shy: I like sketching quiet corners of town. Do you draw?
text.serious: A short sketch is a good way to notice details. Do you make art?

text.default: There are many nice places to see nearby. Where would you like to travel?
text.cheerful: I love a new journey! Where would you like to go?
text.shy: I like short trips to quiet places. Do you enjoy travelling?
text.serious: A good route makes a trip easier. Do you like to travel?

text.default: Learning something new can be fun. What did you like to study?
text.cheerful: School is full of interesting things to learn! What subject do you like?
text.shy: I liked reading at school. What was your favorite subject?
text.serious: Practice helps us improve. What did you enjoy learning?
